target: 台積電交大能源教育館（2017新竹永久版蘭花屋）
scope: Independent source-bounded complete exterior visual review; not measured as-built, present-condition, topology/strength or print certification. No geometry edited.
source_viewing: All listed source images personally viewed during source research; okgo1, okgo3 and paper fig001 personally re-opened during this final review. All five final PNG individually personally viewed. README/SOURCES/design-features and core geometry code inspected.

views.front: East/north full oblique: unequal-pitch roof and offset ridge, east lower sliding-glass zone, north vertical glazing and clerestory, timber front steps/deck and stone-colored plinth. Whole building visible, not neighboring gray block. Internal partitions low-light/partially occluded.
views.rear: West/south full oblique: west narrow dark opening, small divided window, separate patterned translucent bottle-wall band; south externally tilted louver facade; long roof dark parallel bands. Bottle pattern regularized, not exact bottle count.
views.elevation: East gable: pronounced asymmetric profile, transparent lower sliding-door presentation and low-lit inner green-wall pattern; southern tilt visible at side. Closed glazing is solid geometry, not an open-air hole. L-core cannot all be independently seen through this single view; simplified L partitions/ceilings are present in build_model.py and partially visible through obliques.
views.top: Complete roof footprint and two different slope zones; short north clear field plus upper dark modules, long south parallel dark bands, not Fig2 illustrative checkerboard. Exact subdivided module number unverified and disclosed approximate.
views.left_oblique: East/south facade: white tilted south supports and separated horizontal louver blades, east glazing, steps and raised plinth. Internal room fit-out intentionally not reconstructed.

confirmed: Single Taiwan permanent-version greenhouse-shaped enclosure; no 2014 Versailles-only additions or gray neighboring building.
Asymmetric north-short/steep and south-long/gentler roof with offset ridge.
North vertical glazed long facade distinct from outward-tilted south louvers.
West grouped openings and bottle-pattern band distinct from east entrance and from south open louvers.
Completed aerial roof zoning prioritized over explanatory cutaway panel patchwork.
Visible broad front timber steps/deck and stone-colored base retained; extra thin rectangular print base disclosed.
Simplified L low living core and high green core retained rather than wholly solid or completely empty envelope.
limitations: All dimensions, slope/tilt angles, ridge offsets, frame sizes and minor subdivisions are photo-based estimates, not survey dimensions.
Five south dark bands, eight modules per band, twelve north modules, 25 louver blades and bottle pattern are model subdivisions, not independently established actual counts.
Glazing has physical thickness; STL has no transparency; 3MF/Blend Alpha is display appearance, not open geometry or assurance of transparent printed material.
Photographic aerial resolution does not establish west window hardware/function; model correctly avoids assigning a specific service-door operation.
No actual print performed; this visual review does not certify strength, support-free printability, global manifoldness or numerical QA.
2017-04-21 is opening date, 2021-02-10/19 publication/version dates; individual source photograph capture dates unknown, four okgo photos have no EXIF; no 2026 existing-condition claim.
recommendation: Accept the hash-bound exterior approximation with README/SOURCES limitations preserved. Any geometry or image change invalidates this artifact binding.
